entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A loxodon mage-scholar of Lorehold College, Strixhaven, whose spark ignited during the New Phyrexian Invasion, making him a planeswalker.

entities.name: Asterion
entities.description: Quint's spirit mentor who helped him rediscover the lost Loxodon city of Zantafar.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: A professor who tasked the surviving students with finding the Invocation of the Founders.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A student who searches for the Invocation with Quint.

entities.name: Rootha Squallheart
entities.description: A student distracted by the compleated Nassari.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A student who searches for the Invocation with Quint.

entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: A student who searches for the Invocation with Quint.

entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: A compleated figure who distracted Rootha.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A former planeswalker who traveled through an Omenpath to request Quint's help on Ixalan.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A figure Quint helps solve a puzzle to reach Ixalan's caverns.

entities.name: Wayta
entities.description: Welcomed Quint on Ixalan.

entities.name: Abuelo
entities.description: A man whose spirit Quint reanimates and who helps open the door to the Core.

entities.name: Aclazotz

entities.name: Dean Augusta Tullus

entities.name: Mica
entities.description: A geomancer who helps Quint find a Coin Empire reliquary.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: A group who rescue Quint's party and help open the door to the Core.

entities.name: Oltecs

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire whose party began diplomacy with the Oltecs.

entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: An enigmatic planar-spanning civilization Quint believes left a coin motif across many planes.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university of Arcavios where Quint studies.

entities.name: Biblioplex

entities.name: Zantafar
entities.description: A lost Loxodon city Quint rediscovered near Strixhaven.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane Quint visits seeking the Coin Empire.

entities.name: Core

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that burned through Strixhaven's defenses and ignited Quint's spark.

events.summary: Quint is expelled from Rundlestrom Military Academy for clumsiness and then joins Strixhaven University.
With his spirit mentor Asterion's help Quint rediscovers the lost Loxodon city of Zantafar.
events.quote: Quint rediscovered the lost Loxodon city of Zantafar

events.summary: During the Invasion, Quint tries to cover for Rootha at the Invocation of the Founders with raw magic, his spark ignites, and he planeswalks away.
events.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away.

events.summary: Quint explores the Multiverse, and Lorehold believes him dead for months, while he finds a coin motif he calls the Coin Empire.
events.quote: he discovered a mysterious coin motif prevalent across many planes

events.summary: Saheeli asks Quint's help on Ixalan, where he helps Huatli open the caverns and reanimates Abuelo's spirit before mycoids attack.
events.quote: Quint used his magic to reanimate the spirit of a man named Abuelo

events.summary: The vampires break out and free Aclazotz, who turns them into demons; the armies clash, the vampires are defeated, and Aclazotz flees the Core.
events.quote: Aclazotz was released and turned the vampires into powerful demons under his control

events.summary: Quint finds a giant creature in the ruin Colony's End, which moves, prompting him to planeswalk away.
events.quote: it suddenly moved when Quint approached it, prompting him to planeswalk away

events.summary: Two years later Quint returns to Strixhaven as a temporary teaching assistant and with Mica finds a Coin Empire reliquary depicting the Fomori-Eldrazi war.
events.quote: he discovered a Coin Empire reliquary, including a depiction of the Fomori-Eldrazi war
